tools.name: seqcraft_analyze_primer
tools.description: Compute melting temperature, GC content, molecular weight, and exact IUPAC-compatible binding loci on the template construct.

documentId.description: Template document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_analyze_restriction_sites
tools.description: Search for recognition and cut sites of standard restriction enzymes (Type II and Type IIS, e.g. EcoRI, BamHI, BsaI, BsmBI, NotI, HindIII) on the target molecule. Returns 1-based coordinates [start1, end1], forwardCut1, reverseCut1, and overhang types.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_clear_selection
tools.description: Clear the active range selection and unselect any highlighted features or primers in the SeqCraft workspace.

tools.name: seqcraft_compare_documents
tools.description: Perform pairwise biological sequence comparison and alignment between two documents in the workspace. Returns identity percentage, nucleotide differences (substitutions, insertions, deletions), and feature discrepancies.

tools.name: seqcraft_copy_region_between_documents
tools.description: Extract a nucleotide region [sourceStart1, sourceEnd1] from a source construct and stage its insertion into a target construct at targetPosition1. Stages a revision-locked transaction on the target construct.

sourceStart1.description: 1-based inclusive start position on source document.

sourceEnd1.description: 1-based inclusive end position on source document.

orientation.description: Orientation of the copied fragment (default: forward).

tools.name: seqcraft_create_document
tools.description: Create a new sequence document in the SeqCraft workspace from a nucleotide string. Validates sequence alphabet (DNA/RNA IUPAC).

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (5′→3′). Supports IUPAC degenerate bases.

tools.name: seqcraft_create_document_from_region
tools.description: Extract a nucleotide sub-region [start1, end1] from a construct and create a new independent construct in the workspace.

sourceDocumentId.description: Source document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

topology.description: Topology of the new document (default: linear).

tools.name: seqcraft_delete_document
tools.description: Remove a document from the SeqCraft workspace. To prevent accidental deletion during exploration, you must explicitly set confirmDelete: true.

documentId.description: Identifier of the document to remove.

confirmDelete.description: Must be explicitly set to true to confirm deletion.

tools.name: seqcraft_detect_known_features
tools.description: Scan the active or specified sequence against SeqCraft built-in curated biological feature library (promoters, origins, antibiotic resistance markers, reporters, tags). Returns identified matches with positions and confidence.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_domesticate_sequence
tools.description: Scan a sequence for internal Type IIS or standard restriction sites and return revision-bound synonymous mutation candidates to eliminate internal cut sites without altering protein translation. Follow up with seqcraft_stage_domestication_candidate to stage a proposal for human review.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_duplicate_document
tools.description: Create an independent, isolated working copy of an existing document. Useful for safe experimentation, staging edits without altering the original construct, and testing modifications.

documentId.description: Document to duplicate. If omitted, duplicates the active document.

newName.description: Optional name for the new copy. Defaults to "<Original Name> (Copy)".

tools.name: seqcraft_edit_sequence
tools.description: Stage an insertion, deletion, or replacement on a DNA/RNA molecule using 1-based closed coordinates. Evaluates biological consequences (CDS frames, amino acid translations, restriction sites) and stages a revision-locked transaction for human review. Does NOT modify the molecule until the human clicks Apply. Follow up with seqcraft_get_transaction_status.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

operation.description: Structured sequence edit operation (insert, delete, or replace).

start1.description: 1-based start coordinate (for delete or replace operation).

end1.description: 1-based end coordinate (for delete or replace operation).

range1.description: Alternative legacy shorthand for replacement [start1, end1].

sequence.description: Alternative legacy shorthand for replacement sequence.

tools.name: seqcraft_execute_actions
tools.description: Execute a batch of SeqCraft tool actions in sequential order. Rejects recursion. If any action stages a sequence mutation (status: awaiting_approval) or errors in stop_on_error mode, execution halts immediately without executing subsequent actions.

tool.description: Name of the tool to invoke.

actions.description: Ordered list of tool calls to execute.

tools.name: seqcraft_export_document
tools.description: Export the active or specified construct to standard bioinformatic formats: GenBank flat file (including all features and annotations), FASTA, or SeqCraft JSON format. Returns generated text, filename, revision, and sequence hash.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, exports the active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_export_sequence
tools.description: Export the active or specified construct to standard bioinformatic formats: GenBank flat file (including all features and annotations), FASTA, or SeqCraft JSON format. Returns generated text, filename, revision, and sequence hash.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, exports the active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_find_crispr_targets
tools.description: Scan sequence for CRISPR-Cas guide RNA target sites and protospacers across multiple Cas effectors (SpCas9, SaCas9, Cas12a/Cpf1, Cas12e/CasX). Computes on-target quality scores, GC balance, Pol III termination penalties, and MMEJ frameshift predictions.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

nuclease.description: CRISPR Cas nuclease system (default: SpCas9). SpCas9 (3' NGG), SaCas9 (3' NNGRRT), Cas12a (5' TTTV), Cas12e (5' TTCN).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of target sites returned (default: 20).

tools.name: seqcraft_find_orfs
tools.description: Search for open reading frames across all six reading frames using NCBI genetic code table 1 and a configurable minimum codon count.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

minCodons.description: Minimum ORF length in codons (default: 30 codons = 90 bp).

tools.name: seqcraft_focus_region
tools.description: Navigate, scroll, and center the editor view around a specific nucleotide region using 1-based closed coordinates [start1, end1]. Optionally selects the region or switches representation.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

preferredView.description: Optional preferred editor view (e.g. sequence or map).

tools.name: seqcraft_generate_opentrons_protocol
tools.description: Compile a production-ready Python protocol for automated liquid handling on Opentrons OT-2 or Flex robots. Supports PCR master mix distribution and restriction digestion setups.

mode.description: Protocol type to generate (pcr or digest).

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

ampliconLengthBp.description: Expected PCR amplicon length in base pairs.

enzymeNames.description: Restriction enzymes for digestion (for digest mode).

incubationTempC.description: Incubation temperature in Celsius for digest (default: 37).

tools.name: seqcraft_get_active_document
tools.description: Retrieve summary details, topological properties, annotations count, primers count, and revision metadata for the active or specified document.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, returns active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_capabilities
tools.description: Discover SeqCraft scientific workflows, coordinate conventions (1-based closed [start1, end1]), privacy boundaries, approval rules, and suggested agent task sequences. Use this when planning a multi-step interaction or deciding which SeqCraft tools to call.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_document_revision
tools.description: Query the current revision number and canonical SHA-256 sequence hash of a document. Essential for revision-locking proposals, avoiding race conditions, and verifying mutation commits.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, checks the active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_history
tools.description: Retrieve the change history log and undo/redo availability for the active or specified construct.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_pending_transaction
tools.description: Check the lifecycle state (awaiting_approval, applied, rejected, or stale) and provenance of a staged sequence transaction. Call this after staging an edit with seqcraft_edit_sequence or candidate staging tools to check if the human approved the change.

transactionId.description: Identifier of the staged transaction to inspect. If omitted, inspects the current pending transaction.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_selected_context
tools.description: Read the currently selected nucleotide sequence slice and overlapping biological features in 1-based closed coordinates. Use this to inspect what the human user or current selection is highlighting without retrieving the entire molecule.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses the currently selected or active construct.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_transaction_status
tools.description: Check the lifecycle state (awaiting_approval, applied, rejected, or stale) and provenance of a staged sequence transaction. Call this after staging an edit with seqcraft_edit_sequence or candidate staging tools to check if the human approved the change.

transactionId.description: Identifier of the staged transaction to inspect. If omitted, inspects the current pending transaction.

tools.name: seqcraft_get_workspace_context
tools.description: Read the current SeqCraft workspace state, including the active molecule, current selection, selected feature, pending transaction state, active view, and registered tool count. Preferred bootstrap tool for any task involving SeqCraft.

includeDocumentList.description: Whether to include a list of all open document names, IDs, lengths, and topologies in the workspace.

tools.name: seqcraft_import_from_database
tools.description: Fetch and import an authoritative biological sequence from a public repository (NCBI Nucleotide / GenBank, RefSeq, ENA, Addgene) by accession ID into the SeqCraft workspace. Use this tool whenever the user references a known public accession (e.g. J01749.1, NC_001416.1, OQ870305.1) or asks SeqCraft to obtain a biological sequence from a public repository. Preserves sequence topology, GenBank annotations, and origin metadata.

format.description: Format preference: 'genbank' (default, preserves annotations and features) or 'fasta'.

openAfterImport.description: Whether to activate and open the imported document in the workspace immediately. Defaults to true.

tools.name: seqcraft_import_sequence_text
tools.description: Import DNA/RNA sequence data into SeqCraft from FASTA, GenBank flat file, or raw sequence text. Creates and opens the construct(s) in the workspace.

content.description: Sequence file content (FASTA, GenBank flat file, or raw sequence text).

name.description: Optional override name for raw sequence inputs.

tools.name: seqcraft_list_documents
tools.description: List all sequence constructs/documents currently loaded in the SeqCraft workspace with their IDs, names, topologies, lengths in base pairs, and revision numbers.

tools.name: seqcraft_list_features
tools.description: List all annotated biological features (CDS, promoters, genes, origins, resistance markers, tags) on the target construct with their coordinates [start1, end1], strand (+/-), type, and qualifiers.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, lists features for active document.

type.description: Optional filter by feature type (e.g. CDS, promoter, gene, origin).

tools.name: seqcraft_list_primers
tools.description: List all custom oligonucleotides and primers configured for the target molecule, including their sequences, lengths, and binding positions.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_mutate_feature
tools.description: Create, update, delete, or batch-create biological annotations on the active or specified construct using 1-based closed coordinates [start1, end1]. Immediately updates document annotations and records revision provenance.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

feature.description: Single feature input for create or update action.

strand.description: Strand orientation (+ for forward 5'->3', - for reverse complement).

qualifiers.description: Additional GenBank qualifiers (e.g. note, gene, product).

features.description: Array of feature inputs for batch_create action.

featureId.description: Feature ID to delete (for delete action).

tools.name: seqcraft_mutate_primer
tools.description: Create, auto-bind, update, or delete primers on the construct. Action "add_from_sequence" automatically validates the primer, finds binding loci on the template molecule, and attaches the primer to the document.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

sequence.description: 5'->3' primer nucleotide sequence (for create or add_from_sequence).

primerId.description: Existing primer ID (for update or delete).

tools.name: seqcraft_plan_domestication
tools.description: Scan a sequence for internal Type IIS or standard restriction sites and return revision-bound synonymous mutation candidates to eliminate internal cut sites without altering protein translation. Follow up with seqcraft_stage_domestication_candidate to stage a proposal for human review.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_prepare_restriction_clone
tools.description: Simulate restriction cloning between an insert construct and a destination vector using compatible restriction enzyme sticky ends.

tools.name: seqcraft_propose_annotation
tools.description: Automatically detect and apply a known annotation match from the built-in database to the molecule.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

matchIndex.description: 0-based index of the detected feature match to apply.

tools.name: seqcraft_redo
tools.description: Redo the previously undone sequence edit on the active or specified construct in SeqCraft history.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_restore_revision
tools.description: Stage restoration of a document to a historical snapshot in the undo stack. Stages a revision-locked transaction.

documentId.description: Target document ID.

historySnapshotIndex.description: 0-based index in the document undo stack to restore.

tools.name: seqcraft_reverse_complement_region
tools.description: Stage an in-place reverse complement of a sequence region [start1, end1] on the target molecule. Creates a revision-locked transaction for human review.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_rotate_origin
tools.description: Stage setting a new circular origin (position 1) on a circular plasmid. Re-indexes nucleotide coordinates and feature locations. Requires a circular topology and human review.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

newOrigin1.description: 1-based nucleotide position to become the new origin (position 1).

tools.name: seqcraft_screen_biosecurity
tools.description: Run automated biosecurity reference pre-screening against diagnostic signature motifs of regulated Select Agents and Controlled Biological Toxins (Filoviruses, Poxviruses, Henipaviruses, Anthrax, Tularemia, Plague, BoNT, Ricin). Informational diagnostic screening only.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_search_sequence_database
tools.description: Search public biological sequence databases (NCBI Nucleotide / GenBank, RefSeq, ENA / EMBL-EBI, Addgene) for accession IDs, plasmid constructs, genes, or genomes matching a query. Returns compact candidate records with accession, title, organism, length in bp, and molecule type.

provider.description: Target database provider: 'ncbi' (GenBank/RefSeq), 'ena' (EMBL-EBI), or 'addgene'. Defaults to 'ncbi'.

query.description: Search term, organism, plasmid name, gene symbol, or keyword (e.g. 'pBR322', 'eGFP', 'lambda phage', 'cas9').

limit.description: Maximum number of candidate records to return (1-20). Defaults to 5.

tools.name: seqcraft_select_feature
tools.description: Select an existing biological feature/annotation on the active or specified document by its unique feature ID. Highlights the feature in the viewer and opens its properties in the inspector.

documentId.description: Document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_select_range
tools.description: Select a continuous range of nucleotides on the active or specified molecule using 1-based closed coordinates [start1, end1]. Updates the visible editor selection for human and agent context sharing.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses the active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_select_sequence_range
tools.description: Select a continuous range of nucleotides on the active or specified molecule using 1-based closed coordinates [start1, end1]. Updates the visible editor selection for human and agent context sharing.

documentId.description: Target document ID. If omitted, uses the active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_set_active_document
tools.description: Switch the active document tab in the SeqCraft workspace. Use this when you want to view, inspect, or edit a different open construct.

documentId.description: ID of the open document to activate.

tools.name: seqcraft_set_active_view
tools.description: Switch the primary workspace visualization view tab. Available views: map (plasmid/linear map), sequence (base-level nucleotide editor), features (annotation table), primers (primer design panel), enzymes (restriction digests), history (revision log), compare (sequence comparison/diff).

tools.name: seqcraft_show_feature
tools.description: Highlight and focus a specific feature on the canvas / editor view and reveal its properties in the inspector panel.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

featureId.description: Unique identifier of the feature to display.

tools.name: seqcraft_show_restriction_site
tools.description: Highlight a restriction enzyme cut site on the map and editor view.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_simulate_digest
tools.description: Simulate single or multi-enzyme restriction digestion on a circular plasmid or linear DNA. Returns predicted fragment sizes, fragment sequences, and terminal overhang types.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

enzymeNames.description: Enzyme names for single or double digest.

tools.name: seqcraft_simulate_golden_gate
tools.description: Simulate Golden Gate multi-fragment assembly using Type IIS restriction enzymes (e.g. BsaI, BsmBI, AarI). Validates compatible overhang pairs, checks junction fidelity, and returns the assembled construct.

documentIds.description: List of document IDs participating in the assembly in order.

enzymeName.description: Type IIS enzyme driving the assembly (default: BsaI).

tools.name: seqcraft_simulate_pcr
tools.description: Simulate exact-match in silico PCR on a linear or circular template. Returns predicted amplicon coordinates, lengths, GC content, and primer-pair melting temperatures.

documentId.description: Template document ID. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_stage_domestication_candidate
tools.description: Stage an exact synonymous mutation candidate returned by seqcraft_domesticate_sequence. Checks revision locking to ensure the molecule was not modified since analysis, then creates a revision-locked transaction for human review.

documentId.description: Optional target document ID.

tools.name: seqcraft_stage_sequence_transaction
tools.description: Stage an exact synonymous mutation candidate returned by seqcraft_domesticate_sequence. Checks revision locking to ensure the molecule was not modified since analysis, then creates a revision-locked transaction for human review.

documentId.description: Optional target document ID.

tools.name: seqcraft_undo
tools.description: Undo the most recent sequence edit on the active or specified construct in SeqCraft history.

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, uses active document.

tools.name: seqcraft_update_document_metadata
tools.description: Update metadata for a document, such as renaming it or changing its topology (linear <-> circular).

documentId.description: Document identifier. If omitted, updates the active document.
